name: Asherah
title: Witch of Favoritism
description: A noble young lady who joined the Journey to become a Savior like the Star Savior she admires. Her strong drive to act first rather than worry is both her strength and her weakness.
introduction:
A being who travels across countless timelines, searching for a worldline where she can save the Captain.
She knows that to save the Captain in the end, she must destroy the world itself, the <color=#2A80D8>Cycle</color>, and has come to pursue that goal by any means.
She approaches everything with cynicism and detachment, worn down by the boredom and futility of repeating time until almost nothing holds meaning for her anymore.

In the worldline of the Captain and the Voyager Savior Party, she reveals this world's predetermined future and even absorbs a <color=#2A80D8>Void Star</color> to confront the Captain, who still refuses to give up... but in the end, she never achieves what she desires.

...And afterward, she opens her eyes to find herself in the Journey's timeline.
How she ended up here is something she cannot recall.
